STEPS:

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT LimitId,[Timestamp],FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY LimitId,[Timestamp],FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  LimitId,[Timestamp],FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY LimitId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus_WITH_DUP_20230626  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus_WITH_DUP_20230626
--90660

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus
--90660


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[LimitId]
,[Timestamp]
,[StatusCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]

FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus_WITH_DUP_20230626 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT LimitId,[Timestamp],FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY LimitId,[Timestamp],FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus_WITH_DUP_20230626
--90660
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.LimitliabilityStatus
--90660
